key_facts_verified: ETPNav: An et al. TPAMI 2024, arXiv 2304.03047 (NOT Hong CVPR 2023/2024) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03047
VLFM: Yokoyama et al. ICRA 2024, arXiv 2312.03275 — HM3D zero-shot SR 52.5% — https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03275
OpenFMNav: Kuang et al. NAACL 2024 Findings, HM3D SR ~54.9% — https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-naacl.24/
NaVid: Zhang et al. RSS 2024, video-VLM 510k traj SFT, R2R-CE val-unseen SR ~37% — https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15852
Uni-NaVid: Zhang et al. RSS 2025, arXiv 2412.06224, 3.6M multi-task, 5 Hz on A100
NaVILA: Lin et al. RSS 2025, UC San Diego, legged-robot VLN, two-level (VLM mid-level + RL low-level)
VLN-R1: Qi et al. 2025, arXiv 2506.17221, GRPO RFT + Time-Decayed Reward, SR 41 → 49%
ZSON: Majumdar NeurIPS 2022, HM3D ObjectNav zero-shot SR 25.5%
SemExp: Chaplot NeurIPS 2020, Goal-Oriented Semantic Policy trained with RL/PPO (NOT IL), Habitat 2020 ObjectNav Challenge winner SR 17.85%
L3MVN: Yu IROS 2023, HM3D zero-shot SR 35.2%
CoW (CLIP-on-Wheels): Gadre CVPR 2023, arXiv 2203.10421, HM3D SR 12-25%
PIRLNav: Ramrakhya CVPR 2023, HM3D closed-set ObjectNav SR 65%
PointNet: Qi CVPR 2017, T-Net + shared MLP + max pool
PointNet++: Qi NeurIPS 2017, FPS + ball-query + hierarchical, ScanNet mIoU 64% (vs PN 53%)
Depth Anything v2: Yang et al. 2024, 0.6M annotated + 62M unannotated, ViT-L AbsRel 0.074 / δ₁ 0.946 on KITTI
ZoeDepth: Bhat et al. 2023, arXiv 2302.12288
ORB-SLAM3: Campos et al. 2021, GPLv3 copyleft
VINS-Fusion: Qin et al. 2019, GPLv3
DROID-SLAM: Teed NeurIPS 2021; DPVO: Teed 2023, 30+ Hz single GPU
Grounding DINO: Liu IDEA 2023, arXiv 2303.05499, based on DINO detector (Zhang ICLR 2023; distinct from Caron 2021 self-supervised DINO)
OWL-ViT: Minderer Google 2022; OWL-v2 adds self-training
SAM 2: Ravi Meta 2024, SA-V dataset 50K videos + 600K masklets, streaming memory bank
VLMaps: Huang ICRA 2023, LSeg + CLIP pixel features → BEV grid
ConceptFusion: Jatavallabhula RSS 2023, arXiv 2302.07241, multimodal open-set 3D map
GaussianGrasper: Zheng et al. IEEE RA-L 2024, arXiv 2403.09637, ~10 view RGB-D
F3RM: Shen CoRL 2023, ~50 view requirement for stable NeRF
CLIP: Radford OpenAI 2021, 400M image-text pairs; OpenCLIP/LAION-2B 2B+
SigLIP: Zhai Google 2023, sigmoid loss replaces softmax
Habitat 3.0: now supports humanoid + physical interaction (addresses '不能交互' outdated claim)
AI2-THOR: Unity interactive asset scenes (procedural extension is ProcTHOR)
VLN-CE: Krantz ECCV 2020, discrete low-level actions in continuous state space
R2R: Anderson CVPR 2018; RxR: Ku EMNLP 2020 (English/Hindi/Telugu); REVERIE: Qi CVPR 2020; SOON: Zhu CVPR 2021
